propositions: Three rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register in GitHub Copilot CLI due to invalid or non-conforming SKILL.md frontmatter.
rebar-implement and rebar-janitor have descriptions exceeding the 1024-character limit; rebar-debug contains an unquoted colon that breaks YAML plain scalar parsing.
SKILL.md descriptions must be rewritten as YAML folded block scalars (description: >-) to fix parsing and enable trimming to the 1024-character cap while preserving invocation triggers.

A new deterministic lint check (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate all SKILL.md frontmatters at CI time, enforcing YAML parseability, non-empty descriptions ≤1024 chars, and name format compliance.
The lint check must be wired into the make lint target to catch regressions at commit time instead of silently at skill-load time.
